verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs show that transaction-monitoring workflows can generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met, and that manual reviews happen as asynchronous events. That implies a case and review concept exists, but nothing describes assigning cases to analysts or moving them through review and escalation stages. missing for 10: case assignment to analysts, configurable review/escalation stage routing, queue management documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
